unit.unitinstructions:
Taekwondo Pattern Sentences Reverse

This tutor practices the same 68 sentence-level pattern meaning items in reverse. Each card shows the sticky label plus sentence number, such as Choong Moo 1. Say or type the full matching sentence.

  • What you will do: Read or hear the label and sentence number, then respond with the whole sentence transcription.
  • Audio: Text-to-speech is enabled for both prompts and feedback, and speech recognition is enabled for spoken sentence responses.
  • Order: The introduction follows the source table order and is not randomized.

learningsession.calculateProbability: p.y = -0.77 + .665 * pFunc.logitdec( p.overallOutcomeHistory.slice( Math.max(p.overallOutcomeHistory.length-60,  0),   p.overallOutcomeHistory.length),  .966)+ .51* (p.stimSuccessCount) + 11.1 * pFunc.recency(p.stimSecsSinceLastShown,  .443) ; p.probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-p.y));  return p
